question: Should official macOS releases be blocked when Apple notarization or online ticket verification is unavailable, with no signing-only fallback for existing release environments?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes release availability and adds a private operator prerequisite; correctness tests cannot establish the repository’s acceptable publication policy or operational readiness.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed notarization
options.body: Approve the stricter release policy after confirming that the private keychain profile is available to every official macOS release operator.

options.title: Retain a controlled fallback
options.body: Require an explicitly documented, maintainer-approved exception path if release continuity must remain possible during Apple-notary outages.

recommendation.title: Adopt fail-closed notarization
recommendation.body: Approve the stricter release policy after confirming that the private keychain profile is available to every official macOS release operator.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence connects steipete to the proposed release workflow and they are a repository collaborator.
